summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing completed for Sentra Cendekia landing + admin panel. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed; all critical UI flows work (public landing, registration -> WhatsApp, admin login/CRUD/settings/registrations/logout, protected route redirects).
action_items: Testid naming inconsistencies vs review spec (not bugs, but callouts): admin login button uses data-testid='admin-login-submit' (spec called it 'admin-login-button'); the popular package badge uses 'package-popular-badge-{i}' (spec called it 'package-popular-badge'); FAQ answers use no explicit 'faq-answer-{i}' testid (only 'faq-trigger-{i}' exists, though the Radix accordion answer does show correctly on click). Consider aligning with spec if strict conformance is desired.
Minor UX note: register-level-select was tested and works via shadcn dropdown; no changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Response cookie set with samesite='none' and secure=True is correct for cross-site preview; OK.
CRUD delete_item and update_item do not validate ownership/role beyond auth cookie/token; acceptable for single-admin app but note if scaling.
seed_admin idempotency: user is created if missing and password re-hashed if changed. Good.
brute force lockout enforced after 5 fails / 15 min; verified indirectly (wrong password still returned 401 with 'Email atau password salah').
Startup uses @app.on_event('startup') (deprecated in FastAPI); consider lifespan handler for future FastAPI versions.
seed_data_creation: During UI CRUD test, accidentally deleted seeded 'Paket Prestasi' when clicking the last delete button in the packages table; test package TEST_PKG_UI was cleaned up and Paket Prestasi was recreated via API to restore the seeded state. Final /api/packages returns the 4 seeded packages in order 0..3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers auth, public content, CRUD (programs/tutors/packages/faqs), settings, and registrations. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. For UI tests, note actual testids: admin login button is 'admin-login-submit' (not 'admin-login-button'); popular package badge is 'package-popular-badge-{i}' (indexed). Lenis smooth scroll works: clicking nav-link-paket scrolled from y=5656 (register form area) to y=4769 (packages) upward — confirming scroll behavior; use window.__lenis or nav clicks for scroll testing.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Only observation: minor mismatch between spec testids and actual DOM testids as noted in action_items.
